# EverCommerce Founder Eric Remer to Step Down as CEO Aug\. 6 ## EverCommerce Appoints Alex Goor as Chief Executive Officer \(Moderate\) \(Very Positive\) **EverCommerce \(NASDAQ: EVCM\)** announced that its Board of Directors has appointed **Alex Goor** as Chief Executive Officer and Board member, effective **August 6, 2026**\. Goor succeeds founder and CEO **Eric Remer**, who decided to step down from the CEO role and will remain on the Board\. According to EverCommerce, Goor brings over 20 years of experience leading data-driven technology and fintech businesses at ACA Compliance, Interactive Data, Instinet Group and Datek Online\. The company highlights his focus on sharpening execution and applying AI across products and operations\. EverCommerce serves more than **745,000\*** customers across its EverPro, EverHealth and EverWell vertical businesses\. Remer, who founded EverCommerce in 2006 and led more than 50 acquisitions and its 2021 IPO, will continue providing founder perspective and institutional knowledge as a director\. Loading\.\.\.
